Authentic Neapolitan Pizza Dough Recipe

Making traditional Neapolitan pizza at home requires only four simple ingredients: Tipo 00 flour, water, fresh sea salt, and a pinch of active dry yeast. The secret lies in the long, cold fermentation process.

Ingredients

Mix 500 grams of Tipo 00 flour with 325 grams of cold filtered water (65% hydration). Dissolve 10 grams of fine sea salt and 1 gram of instant yeast. Knead until smooth and elastic, then let rise at room temperature for two hours.

Fermentation & Baking

Divide into four equal dough balls, place in an airtight proofing box, and ferment in the refrigerator for 24 to 48 hours. When ready to bake, preheat your pizza oven or baking steel to 900°F (480°C) and bake for 60 to 90 seconds until blistered and airy.
